sermon.title: Job’s Greatest Tragedy Ends: God Finds, Meets With, And Speaks to Job 02/17/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In part four of surviving tragedy, Pastor David G. Kincer shows that Job’s greatest tragedy was losing God’s presence, and it ended when God met and spoke to him. God’s questions humbled Job, who stopped blaming Him. Whatever God chooses is fair, even when believers suffer, and success is measured in character, not possessions.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
